steps.content: The sea of pink light breaks free from the physical cage of the light sticks. The seats turn pink. The barriers turn pink. Where Phanuel reigns, even the speakers turn pink.
Schorl's defenses are riddled with holes by now, and even the Hypercubes on the FAC's chests are slowly losing their color.
At the center of this pink ocean lies a sanctuary of pure, unadulterated white. That is where the angel dwells.

The never-ending hymn of devotion lifts her wings and carries her higher and higher. She looks down upon the hollow shells drowning alongside her in the void, as they bear witness to the birth of an angel.

This is the stage Eliza built for her. This is the gate to paradise she was always meant to open. She has purified this place, she has stripped away everything, leaving but a single obsessive murmur, echoing for eternity: purify, ascend, bliss—
Yet within this pristine illusion where all have fallen, the angel's lowered gaze catches a single gray speck moving against the tide.
Try as it might, the pink cannot taint you.
Red spikes tear through the blissful gospel, piercing layer after layer of the illusion. You press forward step by step into the heart of the sanctum.
